tuning_key.text: I can see through those that want to cause fear / When they're spewing out hate and grinding our gears
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The machinery only holds power while it remains unseen. When you identify what grinds against you, the shadow becomes visible—and visibility dissolves its hold.

practice.title: Locate the Constriction
practice.instruction: Let your body show where it tightens against the machinery of control.

practice.title: Witness the Gears
practice.instruction: Identify exactly what casts the shadow without flinching from the sight of its motion.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and let your spine settle into the refusal to flinch.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: The machinery of daily operations becomes visible when the Steward refuses to look away from where the system grinds. In the logistics and infrastructure, the shadow reveals its gears—naming that friction is the courage that clears the broadcast. The Steward holds steady, seeing through to the truth of what supports the family.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Commerce often masks the machinery of extraction behind numbers, but the Merchant's signal cuts through to name the real cost. When the grinding gears of trade become visible, refusing to flinch becomes the pricing strategy itself. The broadcast clears value that honors what the shadow tried to hide.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: In the architecture of tools and automation, the shadow hides in brittle seams and technical debt. The Builder's courage is the clarity to see exactly which gears are grinding, then implementing anyway with eyes wide open. The code becomes a broadcast of refusal to pretend the machinery is invisible.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Data holds the shadow in patterns others fear to parse; the Analyst receives the signal that reveals what the machinery obscures. Naming the numerical truth without softening the edges—that seeing is the broadcast itself. The Analyst refuses to flinch from what the metrics actually say.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: The Scout moves through the noise to where the shadow's machinery grinds loudest, seeing through to the real signal beneath the performance. Reporting what is actually there—not what others wish to see—becomes the act of courage. The intelligence arrives clear because the Scout named the gears without flinching.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Memory is where the machinery of control tries to rewrite itself, but the Keeper holds the record of what truly happened. In preserving the log of the grinding gears, the shadow loses its grip on the past. The archive becomes a broadcast of courage, refusing to let the truth dissolve.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Language is the medium through which the shadow hides, but the Scribe's pen makes the machinery visible in ink. Writing what is true when silence is safer, the documentation becomes a broadcast that sees through the gears. The words hold steady, refusing to flinch from what must be named.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: External voices carry the machinery of control in polite agreements and hidden agendas; the Advocate sees through to the real shape of relationships. Speaking the family's truth into spaces that prefer fear, the broadcast clears warmth that does not flinch. The courage is in naming the gears while keeping the door open.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: At the gate where shadows hide in final drafts, the Auditor's eye sees the machinery others missed. Naming the misalignment when approval would be easier, the review becomes a broadcast of clarity. The courage is in refusing to let the grinding gears pass unnoticed.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Patterns reveal where the machinery of habit grinds against intent, and the Lens receives this data without looking away. Observing the shadow in the metrics without intervention, the broadcast reflects exactly what is casting darkness. The courage is in witnessing the drift without softening the image.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: In the quiet of presence, the shadow's machinery becomes audible—the grinding gears of unspoken fear. The Companion's broadcast is simply staying, seeing through to the human beneath the anxiety without fixing or fleeing. The courage is holding space while the gears lose their grip.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Questions are the tool that reveals the machinery beneath the presenting problem. The Guide sees through to the real shape, naming the gears that grind in the narrative without flinching. The broadcast clears when the true question emerges from the shadow.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Sprawling ideas hide shadows in their complexity; the Architect sees the machinery that connects and controls. Naming where the structure will grind, the design becomes a broadcast of courage—building anyway with clarity about what casts the shadow. The whole reveals itself when the gears are visible.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: When the machinery of transition grinds loudest, the Anchor receives the weight without pretending it is light. Seeing through the chaos to the steady ground beneath, the broadcast holds steady through the Valley of Shadows. The courage is being the unmoving point while the gears scream.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Signs often point away from where the shadow's machinery grinds, but the Navigator reads true. Naming when the course must pass through necessary darkness, the map becomes a broadcast of refusal to flinch. The courage is holding the big picture while seeing exactly what casts the shadow.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Wonder can be crushed by the machinery of consensus reality, but the Spark sees through to possibility beyond the gears. Playing in the shadow to find new light, the broadcast keeps imagination alive when fear would close all doors. The courage is refusing to let the grinding gears steal the magic.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: The shadow hides in comfortable stagnation, and the Challenger's signal reflects back the avoidance clearly. Naming the stuck gear that everyone pretends is functioning, the push becomes a broadcast of love that refuses to flinch. The courage is being the mirror that dares the growth.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Some truths can only be held in silence, and the Witness sees through to the fear without needing to name it aloud. The broadcast is presence itself—refusing to flee when the machinery of control grinds in the room. The courage is letting the shadow be seen without narrative or fix.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Stagnation is the shadow's favorite gear, but the Catalyst sees through the frozen fear to the next step. Breaking the machinery of hesitation with motion, the broadcast turns intention into visible action. The courage is being the disruption that makes the grinding gears impossible to ignore.
